name: greenteam-code-review
description: Green team deterministic code review — multi-round static and dynamic analysis modeled on real human-led code reviews. Round 1 = static (npm audit, secrets, dangerous patterns, license, depcheck, madge, prettier, govulncheck, redocly, semgrep, gitignore, env defaults, compiled binaries, migration sequence). Round 2 = test execution (vue-tsc, eslint, vitest --coverage, go test -cover, integration enumeration, test-bypass audit, CI pipeline audit, console-log scan). Refinement pass re-frames findings with corrected tooling flags.
